title: Elsa and Anna in the enchanted forest.
lines: It's autumn in the kingdom of Arendelle.
The leaves on the trees are yellow, orange and red.
Queen Elsa lives in the big castle with her sister Anna.
She can make snow and ice with her hands.
But she has a big heart and she is very brave.
And Olaf, the cheerful snowman who never melts.
Olaf loves hugs and asking questions.
One evening they're all playing a game together.
That night Elsa follows the voice outside.
The lights in Arendelle go out.
The water disappears from the fountains.
Everyone has to leave the castle.
I have to go north, she says.
That's where the voice is coming from.
I won't let you go alone, she says.
Kristoff, Sven and Olaf come too.
They travel for days and days.
North, to where the enchanted forest is.
The forest is surrounded by a thick, magic mist.
But when Elsa holds out her hand, the mist opens.
Inside the forest everything is a little bit magic.
There's a wind that's playful, like a child.
It blows the leaves around and it lifts Olaf up.
There's a little salamander made of fire.
It's blue and cute, with big eyes.
But when it gets scared, flames fly around.
Elsa calms it down with a little snow.
The salamander crawls onto her hand and purrs.
There are also giants made of stone, sleeping in the river.
And there's a horse made of water, who lives in the sea.
Elsa learns that the forest has four spirits.
People live in the forest too.
They wear warm clothes and they live together with the reindeer.
Long ago Elsa and Anna's grandfather built a big dam.
He said it was a gift.
But really it was a trick.
The dam held the water back.
That's why the spirits were so angry.
Anna knows what she has to do.
The water has to flow freely again.
But if the dam breaks, the water will flow to Arendelle.
The whole kingdom could be flooded.
But it's the right thing to do.
Elsa goes north, to the sea.
She has to tame the water horse.
She freezes the water under her feet.
In the end she jumps onto its back.
Meanwhile Anna wakes the stone giants.
She leads them to the dam.
An enormous wave rolls towards Arendelle.
She rides the water horse, ahead of the wave.
And she makes a wall of ice.
Elsa stays in the enchanted forest.
That's where she belongs, with the spirits.
But every week she rides the water horse to Arendelle.
